scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Waiting for the Bad News
cards.instruction: Treat pauses, changes, and uncertainty as signs that rejection or loss is approaching, then prepare yourself before it arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've brought a box to the meeting. Is this where you dismiss me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We want to discuss your promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Promotion to what? The box is very adaptable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: More responsibility.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll keep it for the mistakes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You moved our meeting to Friday. I've brought a box for my desk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a promotion. You'll manage the new branch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Away from everyone? I'll pack before they have to say goodbye.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can still come to Friday drinks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll bring my own glass. Better get used to being a visitor before they stop inviting me.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prepares for dismissal, but A5 prepares for mistakes rather than approaching rejection or loss.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 questions B2's promotion; A5 connects B4's responsibility to mistakes, though the box's purpose becomes obscure.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers promotion, but B4's 'More responsibility' supplies little managerial intention or pressure.

heightening.evidence: A5's box for mistakes weakens A1's concrete preparation for losing the job.

specificity.evidence: A1's meeting and packing box establish a playable employment conversation.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's adaptable box is economical, but A5 makes its use metaphorical rather than playable.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats a rescheduled meeting as impending dismissal; A3 prepares for separation; A5 prepares for eventual exclusion despite reassurance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's new branch makes A3 anticipate leaving colleagues; B4's drinks invitation makes A5 prepare to attend as a visitor.

relationship.evidence: B2 offers professional advancement and B4 preserves social contact, giving A two credible forms of reassurance to reinterpret.

heightening.evidence: A5 moves beyond packing in A3 to rehearsing outsider status and anticipating the withdrawal of invitations.

specificity.evidence: A1's Friday meeting and desk box immediately establish a workplace; B2's branch and B4's drinks make the losses concrete.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's own glass economically turns an inclusive invitation into preparation for exclusion, though bringing glassware is slightly contrived.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 locates the promotion at another branch; A3 specifically prepares for separation from colleagues.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers continued attendance at drinks; A5 turns that attendance into practice for becoming an unwanted visitor.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 repeatedly infer approaching loss and make advance preparations.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 extends the anticipated loss from workplace proximity to eventual social rejection.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A interprets changes and uncertainty as approaching loss and prepares before that loss arrives.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: General pessimism can anticipate mistakes without treating a present cue as evidence of impending rejection.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 packs for dismissal; revised A3 treats relocation as separation and A5 extends protective packing to the team.

records.recommendedEdit: The rejected candidate's collective packing could be ordinary relocation assistance. The employment setting remains; B4 now offers continued social inclusion, which A5 treats as temporary access preceding exclusion. Internal reread under coach-1.0: fidelity 5, A1 prepares for dismissal and A5 rehearses becoming an outsider; logic 5, B2's branch causes A3's separation preparation and B4's drinks cause A5's visitor preparations; relationship 4, B2 advances A and B4 preserves contact; heightening 4, A5 anticipates eventual exclusion despite an invitation; specificity 5, A1 establishes a managerial meeting and desk box; brevity/wit 4, A5's own glass makes the feared status change tangible. Total 92. Unlike b's intimate breakup logistics, a prepares for losing workplace belonging.
records.remainingConcern: The personal glass is less natural than the desk box, but the causal chain remains clear. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A5's own glass is unnecessary at ordinary drinks; it must express A's sincere rehearsal of outsider status. The unchanged distinguishingEvidence describes the prior candidate's team packing, which this correction replaces. This is model review only.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved alternative concerns romantic rejection and adapts tissues and containers to dinner plans. This candidate concerns workplace displacement and continued membership of a social group.

cards.title: Waiting for the Bad News
cards.instruction: Treat pauses, changes, and uncertainty as signs that rejection or loss is approaching, then prepare yourself before it arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You paused before answering. Shall I brace for goodbye?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was swallowing tea.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: People prepare their throats for difficult news.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm asking you to dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One last dinner, or may I leave the box at home?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You paused when I asked about Saturday. Should I collect my things from your flat?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was swallowing tea. I'm taking you to dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Somewhere public. I'll bring tissues that fit in my sleeve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's at home. I'm cooking your favourite.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll bring containers. You shouldn't have my leftovers haunting the fridge afterwards.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 treats a pause as goodbye and A3 converts swallowing tea into preparation for bad news.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's throat explanation, but A5 introduces an unexplained box after B4's dinner invitation.

relationship.evidence: B2 corrects the interpretation and B4 invites A, although their relationship remains indistinct.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns B4's invitation into a last dinner, but the new box distracts from that development.

specificity.evidence: A1 identifies a pause without establishing what question or relationship makes goodbye plausible.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's throat interpretation is concise; A5's box feels imported from the other alternative.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 reads a pause as breakup preparation; A3 packs tissues and A5 plans leftover removal before the imagined rejection arrives.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's dinner invitation becomes A3's imagined public breakup; B4's home cooking directly changes A5's preparation to containers.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 offer affectionate reassurance through dinner and a favourite meal, while A5 sincerely anticipates protecting B from reminders.

heightening.evidence: A3 prepares for personal tears; after B4, A5 prepares to erase domestic traces of the relationship.

specificity.evidence: A1's belongings at B's flat establishes intimacy; B2's swallowed tea and B4's favourite meal give actors concrete circumstances.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's sleeve-sized tissues and A5's haunting leftovers express the same fear economically, though the final metaphor is slightly polished.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 offers dinner; A3 assumes a public venue and prepares discreet tissues.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 corrects the venue to home cooking, prompting containers for removing leftovers after the feared breakup.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: Every reassurance becomes another circumstance for advance preparation against rejection.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: Preparation grows from collecting belongings to managing the imagined breakup's domestic aftermath.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A interprets pauses and changing plans as advance evidence of separation and organizes the aftermath.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Seeking reassurance asks B to confirm acceptance; this card makes A prepare materially for expected loss.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 proposes bracing; revised A1 collects belongings and A5 prepares to remove leftovers after an imagined breakup.

records.recommendedEdit: The revision establishes a dating relationship and replaces the unexplained box with preparations caused by each invitation. Internal reread scores: 5, 5, 4, 4, 5, 4; total 92. B4 relocates dinner home, causing A5's fridge and container arrangements.
records.remainingConcern: No rewrite needed. A3 deliberately assumes dinner means somewhere public; delivery should preserve sincere apprehension.
records.writerReservation: A3 assumes the initial dinner is public; that inference is playable but depends on A's fearful interpretation.
records.alternativeComparison: Unlike a's workplace relocation, b uses intimacy and affectionate reassurance to deepen the same anticipated loss.
